properties.title: Items completed by status
properties.query:
SOURCE '__LOG_GROUP__'
| filter stage = "complete"
| stats count() as items by status
| sort items desc

properties.title: Token usage and cost per item
properties.query:
SOURCE '__LOG_GROUP__'
| filter stage = "metrics" and status = "success"
| parse message "Cost: $*, Tokens: */*, cache_create: *, cache_read: *, turns: *" as cost_usd, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_create, cache_read, turns
| display item_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read, cost_usd, elapsed_seconds
| sort elapsed_seconds desc
| limit 100

properties.title: Cost per item (avg / min / max)
properties.query:
SOURCE '__LOG_GROUP__'
| filter stage = "metrics" and status = "success"
| parse message "Cost: $*, Tokens: */*, cache_create: *, cache_read: *, turns: *" as cost_usd, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_create, cache_read, turns
| stats count() as total_items, avg(cost_usd) as avg_cost, min(cost_usd) as min_cost, max(cost_usd) as max_cost

properties.title: Failure Breakdown by Stage
properties.query:
SOURCE '__LOG_GROUP__'
| filter status = "failed"
| stats count() as failures by stage
| sort failures desc

properties.title: Processing Time Distribution (seconds)
properties.query:
SOURCE '__LOG_GROUP__'
| filter stage = "complete" and status = "success"
| stats avg(elapsed_seconds) as avg_s, pct(elapsed_seconds, 50) as p50, pct(elapsed_seconds, 90) as p90, pct(elapsed_seconds, 99) as p99

properties.title: Recent Failures (Last 50)
properties.query:
SOURCE '__LOG_GROUP__'
| fields @timestamp, item_id, stage, status, message
| filter status = "failed"
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50

properties.title: Token Usage Over Time
properties.query:
SOURCE '__LOG_GROUP__'
| filter stage = "metrics" and status = "success"
| parse message "Cost: $*, Tokens: */*, cache_create: *, cache_read: *, turns: *" as cost_usd, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_create, cache_read, turns
| stats sum(input_tokens) as total_input, sum(output_tokens) as total_output by bin(5m)

properties.title: Cost Accumulation Over Time
properties.query:
SOURCE '__LOG_GROUP__'
| filter stage = "metrics" and status = "success"
| parse message "Cost: $*, Tokens: */*, cache_create: *, cache_read: *, turns: *" as cost_usd, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_create, cache_read, turns
| stats sum(cost_usd) as total_cost by bin(1h)

properties.title: Stage-by-Stage Processing Time
properties.query:
SOURCE '__LOG_GROUP__'
| filter status = "success"
| stats avg(elapsed_seconds) as avg_elapsed by stage
| sort avg_elapsed desc

properties.title: Items processed per hour
properties.query:
SOURCE '__LOG_GROUP__'
| filter stage = "complete" and status = "success"
| stats count() as items by bin(1h)

properties.markdown: ## Infrastructure - S3 / DynamoDB / Bedrock / ECR (native AWS metrics)

**Container CPU/Memory:**

AWS/Batch emits no per-container metrics; enable ECS Container Insights on the Batch-managed ECS cluster to graph Fargate CPU/memory.

**Model:** Pinned via the job-definition env var `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` (no image rebuild to change).
